moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio center-punch, written here): Badge (r 34, star) scales 0.18 → 1.32 at 298 ms (power2.out) → 1 at 480 ms (power2.inOut), opacity in over 80 ms; 10 short rays burst outward from r 46 → 62 px, shrinking 13 → 3 px long and fading, from 220 to 600 ms (power2.out). Site exit: shrink to 0.4 + fade, 250 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.48 s) · from (0.18) · peak (1.32) · rays (10).
